label: WS_COLLAB
description: Coordination, audio, transcription, and administration infrastructure for Codex/Copilot workers over durable JSONL event streams with HTTP/HTTPS/WS/WSS parity.
summary: Run the WS_COLLAB server, review its transports, and open its administration console.

mailboxEndpoint.description: Mailbox directory (unread counts, activity, virtual mailboxes); sibling routes /messages, /agents, /send, /cursor share this base.

servicesEndpoint.description: Native self-description: every REST/WS/admin endpoint with auth level and docs (token-gated when auth is enabled).

steps: Install the WS_COLLAB package into the repository .venv.
Start the standalone server, or set WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded to mount it in-process.
Open the administration console and confirm the transports answer.
Stop the standalone WS_COLLAB server (or unset WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded and stop the embedded mount).
This is a vendored nested project (its own .git) -- remove its directory entirely to uninstall it, or leave it and just disable scanning it (set scan: disabled in plugins.json).

plugin-init.description: Redirects /ws_collab to the Workspace Collab plugin.

plugin-lifecycle.note: Runs as its own standalone server by default (set WS_COLLAB_PLUGIN_MODE=embedded to mount it in-process instead). A standalone plugin owns its own process start/stop, so a workbench restart does not restart it -- workbenchShutdown, if implemented, is only a heads-up notification, never a signal to stop or restart this plugin's own server.

status.description: Subsystem rollup with an overall verdict.

config.description: Token-gated operations workbench (same page as configPage).

plugin-api.note: The standalone server self-describes its full endpoint list at GET /ws_collab/endpoints (token-gated) -- this block only names the handful worth surfacing directly on the Plugins page. It has no HTTP restart/shutdown route of its own; stop/start its process the same way you started it.
